spec.description: DCOL v6: RoBERTa-large + LoRA + Contrastive Ordinal Loss. NaN guard + collapse guard + bf16 + grad clip.
spec.command: source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python3 src/dcol_trainer_v6.py --data_dir data/ --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/models/roberta-large-ms/AI-ModelScope/roberta-large --features_path data/features_all.jsonl --output_dir checkpoints/dcol_roberta_v6/ --batch_size 32 --epochs 10 --lr 5e-5 --margin_lr 1e-4 --use_lora --lora_r 16 --lora_alpha 16 --seed 42 --bf16 --max_grad_norm 1.0 --gpu 0

experiment_data.hypothesis: DCOL v6: RoBERTa-large 替代 DeBERTa 解决数值不稳定。lr=5e-5 + grad clip 1.0 + NaN guard + collapse guard (step 500 acc<30% kill)。若 4-class acc > RF baseline (78.2%) 则 DCOL 成功，否则降级为 negative result。
